title: Points of Judgement: a Club Change-Fee Waiver Credited Against an Amendment Charge
content:
An amendment charge on a package among the Vacation Package Products may be reduced by a change-fee waiver the traveller's Wanderlane Traveller Club tier grants. The questions below settle when, and by how much.

**When is a waiver credited back?**

Where the traveller holds a club membership standing active whose tier waives change fees and that membership's ledger shows fewer such waivers used in the last twelve months than the tier grants, the waiver credited back is the administration charge for one traveller. A tier waives change fees where the number of change fees it grants each membership year is 1 or more; the waivers used are those recorded on that membership's points ledger as a waived change fee, counted over the last twelve months taken back from the handling date.

**When is nothing credited back although the tier waives change fees?**

Where the traveller holds a club membership standing active whose tier waives change fees and that membership's ledger shows as many such waivers used in the last twelve months as the tier grants or more, nothing is credited back.

**When does the question not arise?**

Where no such membership stands active, or the tier it stands at grants no change-fee waivers at all — a figure of 0 — nothing is credited back.

| Membership standing | Change fees the tier grants each year | Waivers used in the last twelve months | Credited back |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| active | 1 or more | fewer than the number granted | the administration charge for one traveller |
| active | 1 or more | equal to the number granted, or more | nothing |
| active | 0 | either | nothing |
| not active | either | either | nothing |

*Worked hypothetically.* A tier granting 2 waivers each year, with 1 recorded as used in the last twelve months, credits back the administration charge for one traveller. The same tier with 2 recorded as used in that window credits back nothing.
